news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Awfis Space Solutions from ₹417 to ₹364, citing updated assumptions that combine a lower revenue growth outlook and P/E multiple with slightly improved profit margin expectations and a reduced discount rate. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for May 25, 2026 at 15:00 Indian Standard Time to review audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider additional agenda items (Key Developments).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.93 (up from ₹9.75 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹15.9b (up 31% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹708.5m (up 4.4% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.5% (down from 5.6% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 18%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (1.0x net interest cover). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.1% average weekly change).

news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 1.0x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Awfis Space Solutions Limited Announces Chief Financial Officer Changes
news.body: Awfis Space Solutions Limited announced that Mr. Ravi Dugar, Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, has tendered his resignation from the Company to pursue better career opportunities. He will continue in service up to February 2, 2026, after which he will be relieved. Mr. Dugar served Awfis for over three years and contributed to the successful IPO and transformation of Awfis into a listed entity. The Board of Directors appointed Mr. Sumit Rochlani as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company (Key Managerial Personnel & Senior Managerial Personnel) effective February 3, 2026, on the basis of due recommendations of Nomination & Remuneration Committee and subsequent to the approval of the Audit Committee.
